name: observed-pool-crossing-exclusion-v1
coordinates: the two original ordinal input token IDs in the exact routed source block
candidate_pool: all distinct observed raw labels in that separated source block
exclusion: exact equal rational barycenters in the augmented candidate hull and another observed class hull, with positive tagged query mass only on the candidate side
intersection_search: observed hull separation, vertex containment, query containment and all nonparallel edge pairs; checked integer overflow refuses construction
selection: exactly one candidate survives all attempted exclusions; otherwise keep the parent
prediction: uniform positive mixture of all original source states with the surviving raw label
eligibility: matched unseen input with no earlier observed-hull or observed-point exclusion row, separated ambiguous source block
fallback: exact complete parent for every other query, including zero or multiple survivors
head: mix actual complex source features before multiplication by all unchanged complete coefficients
modes: retain original full/minibatch/forward endpoints, records, repeats and tails
scope: conditional convex-region and closed-pool geometric bias; flatness supplies feature bounds only
